The paper skeleton on `dev` is built, and I checked the bibliography against the literature search. Nothing is waiting on me until results arrive.

- **Build:** the system built `dev` from my last commit (`53377b6`).
- **Bibliography:** all 28 entries exist, and their titles, venues and years match the search. I could only match titles and venues from the search snippets, so the author lists are still from memory. The volume and page numbers I checked from memory against what I know of those papers. I made no edits.
- **Outline:** `story-repo`'s latest revision adds rules for which interval each decision rule uses and how noisy verification truth enters coverage and overstatement. These bear on the experiments section, not on the sections I've written.
- **Blocked:** the method, experiments, discussion, abstract, introduction and checklist all need results and facts from `experiment-repo`. Its `main` is still the initial commit. No version is offered yet.
